description: This file implements an in-memory game service for a memory match card game, including session management, deck generation, and game logic for flipping cards and checking matches.

classes.name: _GameSession
classes.description: Internal in-memory representation of a game session, including game state and properties.

classes.name: _SessionStore
classes.description: In-memory store managing game sessions with TTL eviction.

classes.name: MemoryGameService
classes.description: Main service class providing game creation, retrieval, and card flipping functionalities.

methods.name: _generate_deck
methods.description: Generates a shuffled deck of card pairs based on the board size, with special handling for 4x4 glyph set.

methods.name: _now_ts
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as a float.

methods.name: _make_card_view
methods.description: Creates a CardView object for a specific card index in a session.

methods.name: _make_session_view
methods.description: Creates a GameSessionView object representing the current state of a game session.

methods.name: _clone_session
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a game session for snapshot purposes.
